chip_function.label: CPU
chip_function.description: General-purpose processor executing an instruction stream fetched from memory external to the die.

chip_function.label: Custom ASIC
chip_function.description: Board-specific ASIC spanning two or more top-level categories with no dominant one.

chip_function.label: DMA controller
chip_function.description: Bus-mastering transfer engine moving blocks between memory and devices without per-word CPU involvement.

chip_function.label: DSP / coprocessor
chip_function.description: Fixed-purpose math or signal coprocessor driven by a host CPU, including FPUs and geometry engines.

chip_function.label: Glue logic
chip_function.description: Catalog logic with no system-level identity: 74-series parts, PAL/GAL decoders, drivers, clock generators.

chip_function.label: I/O and system control
chip_function.description: Fixed-function interface parts: port and serial controllers, input handlers, sound latches, interrupt controllers.

chip_function.label: Microcontroller
chip_function.description: Instruction execution plus on-die program store plus integrated peripherals.

chip_function.label: Memory control and storage
chip_function.description: Parts governing the address space or storing data: MMUs, mappers, DRAM controllers, addressable non-volatile stores.

chip_function.label: Protection
chip_function.description: Silicon designed to gate operation: lockout, bus or opcode decryption, keyed challenge-response, tamper response.

chip_function.label: Real-time clock
chip_function.description: Clock/calendar parts tracking wall-clock time across power-off, usually battery-backed.

chip_function.label: Analog audio
chip_function.description: Analog or discrete audio circuitry in the audio path: oscillators, op-amps, filters, power amplifiers.

chip_function.label: Audio DAC
chip_function.description: Digital-to-analog conversion of an audio stream and nothing else.

chip_function.label: FM synthesis
chip_function.description: Synthesis by frequency modulation between operator cells.

chip_function.label: Sample playback
chip_function.description: Sample playback engines (PCM, ADPCM, later codecs) and the address generators that exist only to drive them.

chip_function.label: Programmable sound generator
chip_function.description: Tone generation from a fixed set of square, pulse, triangle and noise channels with envelope control.

chip_function.label: Speech synthesis
chip_function.description: Speech synthesizers driven by LPC, formant or allophone parameters rather than sample replay.

chip_function.label: Wavetable synthesis
chip_function.description: Tone generation from arbitrary short waveforms held in waveform RAM or ROM, looped at a programmable rate.

chip_function.label: Mass-storage controller
chip_function.description: Controllers for a mass-storage medium: floppy, hard disk, CD/GD-ROM, SCSI/IDE, tape.

chip_function.label: Timer / counter
chip_function.description: Programmable interval timers, counters and watchdogs generating timed events or periodic interrupts.

chip_function.label: Blitter / rasterizer
chip_function.description: Drawing engines writing pixels into a framebuffer or line buffer from commands or a display list.

chip_function.label: CRT controller
chip_function.description: Raster timing generation without pixel content: sync, blanking, display address counters.

chip_function.label: Video DAC / encoder
chip_function.description: Conversion of digital pixel data to analog video, and analog video encoding.

chip_function.label: Video mixer / palette
chip_function.description: Digital composition of already-generated layers: priority resolution, palette lookup, blending.

chip_function.label: Picture processor / VDP
chip_function.description: Integrated video processor producing a complete picture from one die: tile layers, sprites and raster timing.

chip_function.label: Sprite generator
chip_function.description: Fetch, position, size, zoom and line-buffering of movable objects.

chip_function.label: Tilemap generator
chip_function.description: Generators of scrolling tile or character background layers, including affine rotate/zoom layers.
